#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int len;
    std::cin >> len;
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;

    int maxLength = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    std::string bufferWord = "";
    bool insideParentheses = false;

    for (int index = 0; index < len; index++) {
        char c = str[index];
        if (c == '(') {
            maxLength = std::max(maxLength, (int)bufferWord.length());
            bufferWord = "";
            insideParentheses = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (bufferWord.length() > 0) {
                wordCount++;
            }
            bufferWord = "";
            insideParentheses = false;
        } else if (c == '_') {
            if (insideParentheses) {
                if (bufferWord.length() > 0) {
                    wordCount++;
                }
            } else {
                maxLength = std::max(maxLength, (int)bufferWord.length());
            }
            bufferWord = "";
        } else {
            bufferWord += c;
            if (index == len - 1) {
                maxLength = std::max(maxLength, (int)bufferWord.length());
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << maxLength << " " << wordCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
